zh: 「01平台接入」只在公司内网出现（与首页 WeLink 内网识别一致）；外网不显示，也不能新建、修改或测试指向 01 平台的模型配置。
账号管理新增「绑定团队」（仅超级管理员）：把账号绑到另一个账号的团队后，共用该团队的抓取脚本、数据导入、报表看板、月报等工具页面数据和模型配置，AI 对话仍各自私有；账号原来的数据保留，解绑后恢复。不能绑进超级管理员空间。
en: 01 Platform quick connect only appears on the company intranet (same check as the home WeLink intranet detection); off the intranet it is hidden and model profiles pointing at 01 Platform cannot be created, changed or tested.

Account management adds Bind team (super admin only): an account bound to another account's team shares that team's scraping scripts, data imports, reports, monthly reports and other tool data and models, while AI chats stay private; its own data is kept and returns after unbinding. Accounts cannot be bound into the super admin space.
